synopsis: King Bomb appears in Grand Bower and the fight begins to Clash of Swords (track 95).
plays_when: in Grand Bower (The Salikawood), the first time the party arrives while King Bomb is undefeated (the battle byte, global byte 0xA16, is 1 from the new game, pre_z0000 line 290, until the win): King Bomb appears and the battle begins (frs_b02 lines 759 and 763, under the tests at lines 585 and 587: the entry-scene byte of slot 4 at global byte 0xCEA is 0). The script sets that byte to 1 as the scene starts (line 754), so a later arrival goes straight to the fight. The map's replay menu, which reads it again, is never reached: the script jumps past it on entry (line 529) and only the menu's own choices jump back into it (lines 552 and 563).

synopsis: King Bomb falls in Grand Bower.
plays_when: in Grand Bower (The Salikawood), when King Bomb is defeated: the script starts it on arrival, with the entry scene the first time (frs_b02 lines 761 and 764) and alone on a later arrival (lines 593 and 595, under the test at line 587), and it holds (frs_b0201 line 69) until the script releases it after the win (frs_b02 lines 670 and 838); the win sets the battle byte (global byte 0xA16) to 2 (frs_b02 lines 734 and 892), so in story play it plays once (the developer menus also store 1 there, at evt_t0505 line 12265 and bin/evctrl line 1102). The map's replay menu, which reads it again, is never reached: the script jumps past it on entry (frs_b02 line 529) and only the menu's own choices jump back into it (frs_b02 lines 552 and 563).
